name: Chidoricho
tagline: Shinagawa in 27 minutes and Shibuya in 35 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000.
summary: The station is in Ota City, served by Tokyu Ikegami Line. Journey times to the main business districts are 47 minutes to Otemachi, 44 minutes to Shinjuku, 35 minutes to Shibuya and 27 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. The station stands 6.6 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 13.8 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 6.6 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 4.8 m to 18.6 m, a difference of 13.8 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of less than 0.5 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 5 also fall inside the area, and the deepest projection is 0.5 to 3 m. Many of the points are inside the projected area, but the projected depths are shallow. Compared with other stations in the 23 wards, the flood projection here is on the small side.

groceries.name: まいばすけっと 千鳥1丁目店

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 5 clinics and 3 pharmacies. The nearest hospital is 東京ちどり病院, about 12 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 松和会池上総合病院, about 19 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Tokyu Ikegami Line.
congestion: Tokyu Ikegami Line runs at 130% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 大崎広小路→五反田; trains from here toward 五反田 pass through it. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥80,000 to ¥90,000 and 1K ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. 1LDK ¥150,000 to ¥160,000 and 2LDK ¥190,000 to ¥200,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is on the high side. schools and parks within walking distance pushes the figure up. On the other side, only one line, the {line}, serving the station holds it down. For 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: For lower rent, Shimomaruko; for how little of the area is in the flood projection, Chidoricho.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Chidoricho. Chidoricho adds the Tokyu Ikegami Line; Shimomaruko adds the Tokyu Tamagawa Line. Shimomaruko is 5 minutes quicker to Shibuya, but times to the other main business districts are much the same. A one-room flat costs about ¥5,000 less at Shimomaruko. On how little of the area is in the flood projection, Chidoricho comes out ahead.

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 5 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 2 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself sits inside the area projected to flood in the heaviest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: Only the Tokyu Ikegami Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
